To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Makrofol N polycarbonate foil is a very efficient Rn, Kr and Xe sorbent and that the Makroful DE polycarbonate foil can be used for the sorption of Rn and Kr, but not of Xe.
the diffusion lengths for 85Kr and for 131mX e are 0.5 and 0.4 cm, respectively, in Makrofol ® N foil and 0.7 and 0.5 cm, respectively, for the same gases in Makrofol DE ®.

Makrofol N® and Makrofol D®E polycarbonate foams are excellent Kr absorbers, with diffusion lengths in the range of 0.2–2.2 cm and that the partition coefficients of Kr from water and air and of Xe from air are in the range of (2–5)×10−4.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the absorption properties of Makrofol ® and especially of the absorption of Rn in this foil.
the development of a new type of passive Rn monitor based on the Makrofol N® polycarbonate foil.
the development of a new technique for the detection of radon and its decay products.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Makrofol N has better properties than Makrofol DE for the absorption of 85Kr in air and water and 131Xe in air and water.
the Makrofol N® foil has a much larger diffusion length and partition coefficient of Kr and Xe than the MakrofolDE® foil.
Makrofol® polycarbonate foams are very good Rn, Kr and Xe sorbers, but the best one is the Makrofol N®.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Makrofol N is the better choice for the application as a Rn, Kr or Xe absorber.
Makrofol® is an effective absorber for Rn and Kr and Xe, and Makrofol N is the best of the two Makrofol® polycarbonates in all cases.
Makrofol® foils are very good absorbers and can be used for a wide range of applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Makrofol® polycarbonates are excellent absorbers of noble gas radionuclides, and they can be considered for use in the future as a component in the design of a noble gas detector.

the absorption of 85Kr in the Makrofol N® foil is so high that the diffusion length of 85Kr is only a few millimeters and that this is the main reason why the Makrofol foils are so effective in the removal of Rn.
Makrofol® foils are very promising for use as radon absorbers and for the measurement of 222Rn and 222Rn progeny in air.
